back: An object stays at rest or moving at constant velocity unless a resultant force acts on it.
Every action has an equal and opposite reaction.
Mass (kg) doesn't change; weight (N) is a force that depends on gravitational field strength, so it changes (e.g. less on the Moon).
$p = mv$ (momentum = mass × velocity) — conserved in a closed system.

front: Are the force/motion equations given in the exam?
back: Yes — all of them are on the AQA Combined Science Physics equation sheet.
